{{Quote|Theses cadets will be the finest troopers we’ve trained. I have faith in them!|El-Les speaking with [[Bric/Legends|Bric]]|<ref name="cadets" />}}
'''El-Les''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and was hired as a [[Drill instructor]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to train [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] on the water [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], along with the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]], who also was a bounty hunter.

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], El-Les was hired with the [[Siniteen/Legends|Siniteen]] [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Bric/Legends|Bric]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to train [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Bric and El-Les often worked together, yet their attitudes on the cadets often clashed.<ref name="cadets" />

==Personality and traits==
El-Les was regarded as compassionate for a bounty hunter, and wished his trainees to do well.<ref name="card" /> This compassionate attitude often clashed with his partner Bric.<ref name="cadets">{{TCW|Clone Cadets}}</ref> Unlike most members of his [[Species/Legends|species]], El-Les did not fall prey to the temptation of [[Salt/Legends|salt]], as indicated by the [[Color/Legends|color]] of his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], which would have turned yellow had he become addicted.<ref name="The Essential Guide to Alien Species real-world book">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}
